notes.title: New Features Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hello Coconut Clickers!

We're happy to announce some amazing updates and new features coming your way!

[list]
[*][b]Revamped Shop:[/b] We've made the shop more challenging and rewarding! Plus, check out our brand-new Space Shop for some interstellar upgrades.
[*][b]Inventory System:[/b] You can now equip and show off the skins that you get from drops while you keep on clicking!
[*][b]Prestige System:[/b] Ready for the ultimate challenge? Prestige once you've fully upgraded your shop and earn a special prize!
[*][b]Leaderboard:[/b] Compete to be the best and earn fantastic rewards! Climb to the top and show everyone who's the real coconut master.
[*][b]More Skins:[/b] Get ready for an array of new coconut skins coming soon!
[/list]

We value your feedback and would love to hear from you. Join our Discord community to share your thoughts and stay updated!
[url=https://discord.gg/Ny8EEKws]Join the Coconut Server[/url]

Thank you for your continued support and happy clicking!

notes.title: Drop Timer Bug
notes.content: Fixed an issue where the timer was counting down in the negatives, if you experienced this issue your timers should not be properly reset and you should start getting drops. If any bugs still persist, please post them on our discord or steam community hub. Happy Clicking!

notes.content: Sorry for the issues that anyone may have had with their inventory! Inventory's are now set to public so hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.content:
[b]FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*]Resolved issue where upgrades could be purchased without having enough coconuts.
[*]Shop menu now remembers the last accessed shop instead of defaulting to the second menu.
[/list]
